nora_patel: kicking off HorizonHealth enterprise POC thread. Sales needs a conservative reserved GPU recommendation + short autoscale/runbook + security blurb for questionnaire. profile: steady 20 rps, short bursts to 400 rps (30-90s) 3x/day, avg 320 tokens, heavy 1200 tokens.

kevin_wu: perf: planned model MH-XL quantized ~= 10.5k tokens/s per A100-equivalent; use 10k t/s for safety. steady tokens/s = 20*320=6400 -> ~0.64 GPU -> baseline 1.

sasha_jones: recommend reserved=4 (approx 3.5x steady) to cover sustained bursts and provide AZ failover headroom; keep min_gpus=1 to avoid cold starts. Use burst credits and short preheat window.

mike_hart: autoscale snippet for SOW (pasteable): ```autoscale_policy:
  reserved_gpus: 4
  min_gpus: 1
  burst_credit_tokens: 1600
  scale_up_if: p95_latency_ms > 350 OR queue_depth > 40
  scale_down_if: p95_latency_ms < 220 for 8m
  preheat: kv_seed_top25pct (synthetic, no PII)
```

kevin_wu: security one-liner for questionnaire: "KV preheat uses anonymized synthetic prefixes and executes within the customer's network boundary for Dedicated/Private deployments; Redwood-managed preheat jobs do not receive customer PII."

sasha_jones: AZ/eviction note: reserved pool can be pinned across 2 AZs; with reserved=4 we can tolerate a single AZ impairment for transient windows. cross-region autoscale recommended for longer disruptions. add runbook note.

infra-bot: preheat template created -> job id hh-preheat-4807654321.

nora_patel: action items: (1) kevin run cost sim reserve1/reserve4/on-demand-burst and post delta (2) mike add autoscale snippet to SOW draft (3) sasha confirm AZ pin wording. will update sales in 12h. :thumbsup:
